description: Inspect a data URI or raw Base64 the same way as the Base64 to image page: detected format, byte length, and dimensions when the header can be read. Or wrap raw Base64 in a data URI. Does not accept or return image files, and does not store the input.

mime.description: For wrap, the MIME type to put in the data URI, default image/png

name: base64_to_image
title: Inspect Base64 or a data URI, or wrap one
